swirl_lamb_oseen.meaning: r_max**2 = alpha * sigma**2 when exp(-alpha r^2/r_max^2) is written exp(-r^2/sigma^2)
swirl_lamb_oseen.source: Canivete Cuissa & Steiner (2022), arXiv:2210.05223, Sect. 2.4, Eq. (10) (PDF text read 2026-09-23)

reynolds_transport_theorem.statement: d/dt int_{Omega(t)} f dV = int_{Omega(t)} df/dt dV + int_{dOmega(t)} (v_b . n) f dA
reynolds_transport_theorem.v_b: velocity of the area element (not the flow velocity)
reynolds_transport_theorem.fixed_region: v_b = 0 -> d/dt int f dV = int df/dt dV

leibniz_integral_rule.statement: d/dx int_a(x)^b(x) f(x,t) dt = f(x,b(x)) db/dx - f(x,a(x)) da/dx + int_a^b df/dx dt
